description.value: A BC Parks campground set in lush second-growth forest at Mermaid Cove, 1 km north of the Saltery Bay ferry terminal on Hwy 101; rocky shoreline tidal pools, ocean swimming, scuba diving, and occasional orca and sea lion sightings from shore make it a genuine overnight anchor on the Sunshine Coast.

address.value: Forge Rd, Powell River, BC V8A 0N1, Canada
